s: strI, daSamahAvidyAntargatadevIviSezaH । taduktaM tantrAntare । “brahmAstraM saMpravakzyAmi sadyaHpratyayakArakam । sADakAnAM hitArTAya stamBanAya ca vEriRAm ॥ yasyAH smaraRamAtreRa pavano'pi sTirAyate । praRavaM sTiramAyAYca tataSca vagalAmuKi ॥ tadante sarvvaduzwAnAM tato vAcaM muKaM padam ॥ stamBayeti tato jihvAM kIlayeti padadbayam ॥ budDiM nASaya paScAttu sTiramAyAM samAliKet । liKecca punaroNkAraM svAheti padamantataH ॥ zawatriMSadakzarI vidyA sarvvasampatkarI matA ॥” sTiramAyAM hlI~ । taTA ca । “vahrihInendramAyAyuk sTiramAyA prakIrttitA ॥ o~ hlI~ vagalAmuKI sarvvaduzwAnAM vAcaM muKaM stamBaya jihvAM kIlaya kIlaya budDiM nASaya hlI~ o~ svAhA ॥ * ॥ tantrAntare । “vahrihInendramAyAyuk vagalAmuKi sarvvayuk । duzwAnAM vAcamityuktvA muKaM stamBaya kIrttayet ॥ jihvAM kIlaya budDiM tat vinASaya padaM vadet । punarbbIjaM tatastAraM vahnijAyAvaDirBavet । tArAdikA catustriMSadakzarA vagalAmuKI ॥” o~ hlI~ vagalAmuKi sarvvaduzwAnAM vAcaM muKaM stamBaya jihvAM kIlaya budDiM vinASaya hlI~ o~ svAhA । ityapi mantrAntaram ॥ * ॥ anayoH pUjA । prAtaHkftyAdiprARAyAmAntaM viDAya fzyAdinyAsaM kuryyAt । yaTA, Sirasi nAradafzaye namaH । muKe tfzwupCandase namaH । hfdi vagalAmuKyE devatAyE namaH । guhye hlI~ bIjAya namaH । pAdayoH svAhASaktaye namaH । “nArado'sya fziM mUrdDni tfzwup CandaScatanmuKe । SrIvagalAmuKIM devIM hfdaye vinyasettataH । hlI~ bIjaM guhyadeSe tu svAhASaktistu pAdayoH ॥” tataH karANganyAsO । o~ hlI~ aNguzWAByAM namaH । vagalAmuKi tarjanIByAM svAhA । sarvvaduzwAnAM maDyamAByAM vazaw । vAcaM muKaM stamBaya anAmikAByAM hU~ । jihvAM kIlaya kIlaya kanizWAByAM vOzaw । budDiM nASaya hlI~ o~ svAhA karatalapfzWAByAM Paw । evaM hfdayAdizu । taTA ca divyatantre । “yugmabARezusaptAhiSezArRESca manUdBavEH । karaSAKAsu talayoH karANganyAsamAcaret ॥” tato mUlAnte AtmatattvavyApinIvagalAmuKISrIpAdukAM pUjayAmi iti mUlADAre । mUlAnte vidyAtattvavyApinIvagalAmuKISrIpAdukAM pUjayAmi Sirasi । mUlAnte SivatattvavyApinIvagalAmuKISrIpAdukAM pUjayAmi sarvvANge । tataSca । “mUrdDni BAle dfSoH Srotre gaRqayornAsayoH punaH । ozWayormmuKavftte ca dakziRAMSe ca kUrpare ॥ maRibanDe'NgulermmUle gale ca kucayorhfdi । nABO kawyAM guhyadeSe vAmAMSe kUrpare taTA ॥ maRibanDe'NgulermmUle tataSca vinyaset punaH । dakzavAme corujAnvorgul PayoraNgulimUlayoH । krameRa mantravarRAstu nyasya DyAyet yaTAviDi ॥” * ॥ tato DyAnam । “maDye surAbDimaRimaRqaparatnavedIsiMhAsanoparigatAM paripItavarRAm । pItAmbarABaraRamAlyaviBUzitANgIM devIM smarAmi DftamudgaravErijihvAm ॥ jihvAgramAdAya kareRa devIM vAmena SatruM paripIqayantIm । gadABiGAtena ca dakziRena pItAmbarAQyAM dviBujAM namAmi ॥” evaM DyAtvA mAnasEH sampUjya bahiHpUjAmAraBet ॥ * ॥ tatra praTamato'rGyasTApanam । yaTA । azwANgulaM caturasraM ziDAya ISAnAdikoRezu pUrvvAdidikzu ca kusumAkzataraktacandanErmlOM gaRapataye namaH ityanena gajadAnena saMpUjya tena maDunA vA arGyapAtramApUrayet । tato vAratrayaM vidyayA saMpUjya aNgAni vinyaset । tato Denuyonimudre pradarSya tenodakena AtmAnaM pUjopakaraRaYcAByukzayet ॥ * ॥ asyA yantram । tryasraM zaqasraM vfttamazwadalaM BUpurAnvitam । tato mUlamuccAryyaM o~ ADAraSaktikamalAsanAya namaH । evaM SaktipadmAsanAya namaH । pUrvvavat DyAtvA pIWe AvAhya zaqaNgAni nyaset । tato mudrAM pradarSya purataH zaqaNgena maRqalaM yajet । tato mUlena mantrayitvA Denuyonimudre pradarSya AtmavidyASivEstattvErbindutrayaM muKe kziptvA tarjanyaNguzWayogena sANgAvaraRAM vagalAmuKIM tarpayet । tato yaTAsamBavamupacArEH saMpUjya AvaraRapUjAmAraBet । zawkoRezu pUrvve o~ suBagAyE namaH । evamagnikoRe BagasarpiRyE । ISAne BagAvahAyE । paScime BagasidDAyE । nErfte BagapAtinyE । vAyO BagamAlinyE । tato'zwadalapatrezu brAhmyAdyAH pUjyAH । patrAgrezu o~ jayAyE namaH । evaM vijayAyE । ajitAyE । aparAjitAyE । stamBinyE । jamBinyE । mohinyE । AkarziRyE । tato dvArezu o~ BEravAya namaH । tadbAhye indrAdIn vajrAdIn pUjayet । tato mUlena DUpAdikaM dattvA yaTASakti japaM viDAya triSUlamudrAM pradarSya puzpAYjalitrayaM dattvA devyEyonimudrAM pradarSayet । tato BEravAya valiM dadyAt । tato visarjanAntaM karmma samApayet ॥ asya puraScaraRaM lakzajapaH । taTA ca । “pItAmbaraDaro BUtvA pUrvvASABimuKasTitaH । lakzamekaM japenmantraM haridrAgranTimAlayA ॥ brahmacaryyarato nityaM prayato DyAnatatparaH । priyaNgukusumenApi pItapuzpESca homayet ॥” * ॥ dvitIyamantrasya tu nyAsAdikaM sarvvaM pUrvvavat । DyAnantu । “gamBIrAYca madonmattAM svarRakAntisamapraBAm । caturBujAM trinayanAM kAmalAlasamAnasAm ॥ mudgaraM dakziRe pASaM vAme jihvAYca vajrakam । pItAmbaraDarAM devIM dfQapInapayoDarAm । hemakuRqalaBUzAYca svarRasiMhAsanasTitAm ॥” * ॥ aTa prayogaH । “kurute vAggatistamBaM duzwAnAM budDinASanam । japahomaprayoge ca mantraM cApyayutaM japet ॥ haridrAharitAlAByAM lavaRaM juhuyAnniSi । stamBayet parasEnyAni nAtra kAryyA vicAraRA ॥ aTavA pItapuzpESca trimaDvaktESca homayet । stamBanezu ca sarvvezu prayogaH pratyayAvahaH ॥” * ॥ yantrantu । “o~kArayoH saMmuKayorUrdDvADaHSirasorliKet । maDyagaM nAma sADyasya tadbAhye cAkzaradbayam ॥ bIjaM dvitIyavargasya tftIyaM binduBUzitam । caturddaSasvaropetaM saMliKet pfTivIgatam ॥ WakAreRa samAvezwya catuzkoRapuwaM bahiH । tatkoRareKAsaMsaktEH SUlErvvajrAzwakaM liKet ॥ triSUlamaDyareKAyAH pfTvI bIjAni pArSvayoH । azwazvapi ca koRezu tadbahirvvagalAM liKet ॥ pfTivyantaritaM bAhye mAtfkAparimaRqalam । Avezwya cAzwaDA paScAttadbAhye sTiramAyayA ॥ niruDyANkuSabIjena nAdasaMmilitANGriRA । liKet pUrvvavadAvezwya paScAcca vagalAmuKIm ॥ pawwe pAzARapawwe vA haridronmattatAlakEH । divyastamBe muKastamBe liKitvA gAQamAkramet ॥ vivAde yantramAliKya BUrjje tEreva vastuBiH । kumBakArasya cakrasya Bramato viparItataH ॥ mfttikAM samupAdAya vfzaBaM kArayettataH । yantraM tasyopari nyasya tAlakena vilipya ca ॥ tannAsAyAM viniH kzipya pItarajjuM nije gfhe । arccayettaM catuzkAlaM nityaM pItopacArataH । duzwasya stamBayatyeva muKaM vAcaspaterapi ॥” iti vagalAparicCedaH ॥ * ॥ viSvasAre । “kAlI tArA mahAvidyA zoqaSI BuvaneSvarI । BEravI CinnamastA ca vidyA DUmAvatI taTA ॥ vagalA sidDavidyA ca mAtaNgI kamalAtmikA । etA daSa mahAvidyAH sidDavidyAH prakIrttitAH ॥” aTa vagalAmuKIstotram । “maDye suDAbDimaRimaRqaparatnavedIsiMhAsanoparigatAM paripItavarRAm । pItAmbarABaraRamAlyaviBUzitANgIM devIM BajAmi DftamudgaravErijihvAm ॥ jihvAgramAdAya kareRa devIM vAmena SatruM paripIqayantIm । gadABiGAtena ca dakziRena pItAmbarAM tAM dviBujAM BajAmi ॥ calatkanakakuRqalollasitacArugaRqasTalIM lasatkanakacampakadyutimadinduvimbAnanAm । gadAhatavipakzakAM kalitalolajihvAYcalAM smarAmi vagalAmuKIM vimuKasanmanaHstamBinIm ॥ pIyUzodaDimaDyacAruvilasadraktotpale maRqape yatsiMhAsanamOlipAtitaripupretAsanADyAsinIm । svarRABAM karapIqitArirasanAM BrAmyadgadAviBramAmitTaM DyAyati yAnti tasya vilayaM sadyo'Ta sarvvApadaH ॥ devi tvaccaraRAmbujArccanakfte yaH pItapuzpAYjalIn BaktyA vAmakare niDAya ca manuM mantrI manojYAkzaram । pIWaDyAnaparo'Ta kumBakavaSAt bIjaM smaret pArTivaM tasyAmitramuKasya vAci hfdaye jAqyaM Bavet tatkzaRAt ॥ vAdI mUkati raNkati kzitipatirvESvAnaraH SItati kroDI SAmyati durjanaH sujanati kziprAnugaH KaYjati । garvvI Karvvati sarvvavicca jaqati tvanmantraRAyantritaH SrInitye vagalAmuKi pratidina kalyARi tuByaM namaH ॥ mantrastAvadalaM vipakzadalane stotraM pavitraYca te yantraM vAdiniyantraRaM trijagatAM jEtraYca citraM na te । mAtaH SrIvagaleti nAma lalitaM yasyAsti jantormmuKe tvannAmagrahaRena saMsadi muKastamBo BavedvAdinAm ॥ duzwastamBanamugraviGnaSamanaM dAridryavidrAvaRaM BUBfdBUSamanaM valanmfgadfSAM cetaHsamAkarzaRam । sOBAgyEkaniketanaM mama dfSoH kAruRyapUrRAmftaM mftyormmAraRamAvirastu pUrato mAtastvadIyaM vapuH ॥ mAtarBaYjaya me vipakzavadanaM jihvAYcalAM kIlaya brAhmIM mudraya nASayASu DizaRAmugrAM gatiM stamBaya । SatrUM ScUrRaya devi tIkzRagadayA gOrANgi pItAmbare viGnOGaM vagale hara praRamatAM kAruRyapUrRekzaRe ॥ mAtarBEravi BadrakAli vijaye vArAhi viSvASraye SrIvidye saMmaye maheSi vagale kAmeSi rAme rame । mAtaNgi tripure parAtparatare svargApavargaprade dAso'haM SaraRAgataH karuRayA viSveSvari trAhi mAm ॥ saMramBe cOrasaNGe praharaRasamaye banDane vyADimaDye vidyAvAde vivAde prakupitanfpatO divyakAle niSAyAm । vaSye vA stamBane vA ripuvaDasamaye nirjane vA vane vA gacCaMstizWaMstrikAlaM yadi paWati SivaM prApnuyAdASu DIraH ॥ nityaM stotramidaM pavitramiha yo devyAH paWatyAdarAdvftvA yantramidaM taTEva samare bAhO kare vA gale । rAjAno harayo madAnDakariRaH sarpA mfgendrAdikAste vE yAnti vimohitA ripugaRA lakzmIH sTirAH sidDayaH ॥ tvaM vidyA paramA trilokajananI viGnOGasaMCedinI yozAkarzaRakAriRI janamanaHsammohasandAyinI । stamBotsAraRakAriRI paSumanaHsammohasaMdAyinI jihvAkIlanaBEravI vijayate brahmAdimantro yaTA ॥ vidyA lakzmIH sarvvasOBAgyamAyuH puttrEH pOttrEH sarvvasAmrAjyasidDiH । mAnaM Bogo vaSyamArogyasOKyaM prAptaM tattadBatale'smin nareRa ॥ yat kftaM japasannAhaM gaditaM parameSvari । duzwAnAM nigrahArTAya tadgfhARa namo'stu te ॥ brahmAstramiti viKyAtaM trizu lokezu viSrutam । guruBaktAya dAtavyaM na deyaM yasya kasyacit ॥ pItAmbarAM dviBujAYca trinetrAM gAtrakojjvalAm । SilAmudgarahastAYca smarettAM vagalAmuKIm ॥ prAtarmmaDyAhrakAle stavapaWanamidaM kAryyasidDipradaM syAt ॥” iti rudrayAmale vagalAmuKIstotraM samAptam । iti kfzRAnandakftatantrasAraH ॥
